concerns.text: FR-005 specifies that the system MUST calculate the Phase Lag Index (PLI) across all electrode pairs, but the Idea Md methodology sketch (and User Story 2 acceptance scenario) refer to calculating neural synchrony using the Phase‑Locking Value (PLV). This creates a conflict over which synchrony metric should be implemented.
FR-012 repeats the normality‑test‑driven selection of Pearson vs. Spearman correlation already covered in FR-006, resulting in redundant requirements.
